title: Brand Localized Name
description: A localized name using the legacy underscore-separated language/region key convention (for example 'en_US', 'fr_CA', or 'zh_CN') and a name value. Bare language codes such as 'en' are also accepted for backwards compatibility. These keys are not AdCP locale-tag values: a bridge to /schemas/core/locale-tag.json replaces '_' with '-', applies the AdCP canonical wire profile, and validates the result rather than passing the key through unchanged.
